info.title: SEAOTTER API
info.description: SEAOTTER control plane API — managed Hermes Agent hosting. Authenticate with a Clerk session JWT (web) or an org-scoped API key (`Authorization: Bearer so_…` from POST /api/v1/api-keys). Public developer docs: https://docs.seaotter.dev

put.description: Store an integration secret in Google Secret Manager and record a `gsm:` ref on the agent. Re-PUTting the same key adds a new GSM version (rotate). Hermes loads the key at startup as an environment variable. Running agents restart so the new mapping is applied; paused/stopped agents pick it up on next start. Returns operation_id; `pending_reconcile` means desired state is durable and safe to retry via reconcile.

delete.description: Remove a `gsm:`-backed integration secret: drop the env ref, rollout without the key, then delete the exact referenced GSM secret. IAM dies with the secret. Partial failures return `pending_reconcile` for safe retry.

dashboard_warming.title: Dashboard Warming
dashboard_warming.description: True while the Hermes dashboard may be briefly unavailable after a pod restart (secrets, Restart, credential rotate). Poll GET /agents/{id}/dashboard-reachability until clear.

credential_rotation_pending.title: Credential Rotation Pending
credential_rotation_pending.description: True while a credential rotation is still converging onto the live Hermes gateway. Prefer waiting / retrying talk rather than assuming the revealed key is already accepted.

env_vars.title: Env Vars
env_vars.description: Non-secret env only. Keys that look like secrets (API_KEY, TOKEN, PASSWORD, …) must use PUT /agents/{id}/secrets. gsm: refs are preserved.

HTTPBearer.description: Clerk session JWT for the web app (active organization required), or an organization-scoped SEAOTTER access key (`so_…`) from POST /api/v1/api-keys for programmatic / docs try-it / MCP use. The same `so_…` value is both `Authorization: Bearer so_…` and `SEAOTTER_API_KEY`.
